Claude Code Prompts.

A personal library of reusable Claude Code prompts. Each prompt lives in its own markdown file: a plain description of what it does and the full prompt text. Pick one, copy it, and paste it into Claude Code, which reads the full prompt from this site.

Prompts

Add PromptAdd a new prompt to the site by providing the raw prompt text: Claude Code generates the title, description, and updates all required files. DocumentationMake any project easy to understand, hand over, and keep building, with four clear documents and sensible defaults set up in one run. Mobile AuditCheck every page at seven screen widths for overflow and layout bugs, fix the root causes, and verify with DOM measurements rather than screenshots. GitHub WikiBuild or update a repository's GitHub wiki from its documentation, curated into Home, Product Overview, Patch Notes, and other pages with a sidebar. Prompt AuditFind the instructions in a project's prompts, skills, and CLAUDE.md files that were written for older models, and fix the ones that now hold it back. Brand IdentityBuild a complete logo system for a project: a brand brief, three SVG concepts, every lockup and icon size, a presentation, and a client deck. iOS SimulatorSet up Xcode and the simulator, build and launch your iPhone or iPad app, then check it at every screen size, in dark mode, and with large text. Game SetupSet up a three.js game with Vite and TypeScript, a fixed-step game loop, input, audio, and asset systems, then build a small playable slice. Motion DesignCreate a looping UI motion video entirely in code: one shape morphing through interface states in time with a song, driven by a cursor. Assumption CheckHave Claude list what it assumes about your code, marked verified or guessed, check the cheap guesses, and propose fixes without changing anything. Progress DashboardKeep a live progress dashboard for a long task, generated by a script from your project's own files so it never goes stale. Launch VideoTurn your project into a short launch video with music, motion, and share copy, using the /brag plugin installed once for every project. Animation PerformanceMeasure a page's animations, pause what runs offscreen, fix leaks that slow long sessions, and prove it with before and after numbers. Design ReviewReview a site's design for defects and decoration with no job, citing each element, ranked by priority, and fixed by removing things first. Landing PagePlan and write a landing or pricing page around one action: the questions to answer first, the section order, the copy, the FAQ, and indexing advice. Score to TargetName a bar like 8 out of 10. Claude writes the rubric, scores each item from real evidence, and improves the weakest round by round until all pass. Video to PromptTurn a screen recording of a site or animation into one detailed prompt that can rebuild it: layout, motion, scroll, assets, and mobile behavior. Frontend ReferencesGive Claude a standing rule for when to use proven design references for style, components, motion, and demo videos, with nothing installed unasked. Prompt WritingWrite a new prompt, or tighten one you already use, so it works with how models actually read, reason, and fail. Project DefaultsGive any project clear house rules and a ready docs folder in one quick pass, while keeping every rule and document it already has. LinkedIn AuditScore your LinkedIn profile part by part, then get a rewritten headline, about, featured posts, and experience, plus a month of posts. Condense DocsShrink your project's docs to what is true now: one home for every fact, history moved to the patch notes, and a table proving nothing was lost. SEO AuditFind why search engines miss your site, measure every page against the technical checklist, fix what code can fix, and list what only you can do. E-commerce SiteBuild an online shop: a landing page that sells, a filterable catalogue, product pages with options, and a cart drawer, with no invented reviews.
